title: STATE.md frontmatter — Claude Code Autonomous Framework

schema_version.description: Schema version of STATE.md frontmatter format.

current_version.description: Semantic version of the currently active project version.

last_action_at.description: When the loop last recorded an action. Written by lib/update-state.mjs; read since v1.8.0 by core/gates.mjs, which warns the agent when it has stood still longer than stall_timeout_minutes. An absent or unparseable value is never treated as silence.

last_session_id.description: Captured from Claude Code session for --resume after crash.

open_findings.description: P0-P3 issues not yet closed (populated by audit stages).

iteration.description: Ralph Loop iteration counter (incremented by Stop-hook).

max_iterations.description: Cap on Ralph Loop iterations before a forced stop plus an alert. Opt-in since v1.9.0: absent, null, 0 or negative all mean there is no cap, and a fresh project is created without one. A positive number behaves as it always did. Keep it below CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP (core/loop-limits.mjs), or a single session is stopped by that backstop first and the cap you set is not the one that applies; the loop says so when it happens.

stall_timeout_minutes.description: How long docs/STATE.md may stay untouched before the continuation text warns the agent about it (v1.8.0). Default 20 when absent. This is a WARNING and never a stop: a false stop costs more than a false warning, because the loop exists to run without a human.

attempts_per_task.description: DEAD FIELD, kept only so existing projects still validate (v1.11.0). It was meant to drive a three-strikes blocker; that mechanism was never implemented, and v1.11.0 removed the promise rather than building it — both halves of the idea are invisible to a driver, which sees change or no change, never a task or a failure. Nothing reads this field. New projects are no longer created with it.

completed.description: Set after successful commit. Eligible for GC after 30 days.

version_cost_usd.description: Spend accumulated for the current version. Written by core/supervisor.mjs only, which gets the turn cost back from the engine. The Stop hook cannot write it: the Stop payload carries a transcript path, and the transcript holds token counts but no cost field. So under the Stop hook this stays at 0 and cap_usd cannot fire — the loop reports that rather than pretending to guard.

cap_usd.description: Spending cap for the current version. Opt-in: absent, null or 0 mean no cap, and a fresh project is created without one. Enforced only where version_cost_usd is actually written (the supervisor).

released_version.description: Set when project reaches release. Stop-hook returns clean exit + Telegram.

next_step_prompt.description: The instruction for the next iteration. It is a CACHE of what to do now; the real source is where the loop stands (current_version + current_stage + current_prompt_file, read against the roadmap). Since v1.7.0 lib/update-state.mjs refuses a patch that moves any of those three fields without also rewriting this one. Setting it to null is allowed and means "work it out from STATE".

next_step_prompt_meta.description: The freshness passport of next_step_prompt, written by lib/update-state.mjs on every write. NEVER edit it by hand: a passport maintained by hand would be a second cache with the same disease. core/gates.mjs compares it against the live position and refuses to hand out an instruction written for a position the loop has left; `at` is for humans reading the file and takes no part in the check. Absent in projects created before v1.7.0 — those fall back to a conservative heuristic over the version named in the text.

version.description: current_version at the time the instruction was written.

stage.description: current_stage at the time the instruction was written.

prompt_file.description: current_prompt_file at the time the instruction was written.

at.description: When it was written (ISO 8601). Diagnostic only.

framework_version.description: The framework release that bootstrapped this project. A historical fact, written once at bootstrap and deliberately NOT updated afterwards: overwriting it would erase the answer to "which release created this project", which is exactly what you need when diagnosing an old project. The version RUNNING right now is a different fact and is not stored here at all — read it from .claude-plugin/plugin.json.

versions_since_last_audit.description: Counter incremented on each completed version. Stage 3 auto-triggers when >= 10.

required_tools.description: Names of MCP servers and tools REQUIRED for the project. The pre-flight check compares them against `claude mcp list`; a missing requirement produces a missing_resource blocker.

stage0_answers.description: Answers collected from user during Stage 0 (goal-setting). Populated by orchestrator-wrapper v0.0.3+.
